notes: Cursor is keyset over (recorded_at, rowid), never engine seq: seq is one global counter shared by threads, so a hole in it is interleaving, not loss. event_gaps remains the only loss record.
Schema v10 is additive and nullable; pre-v10 rows keep item_id NULL and are reported as unknown identity rather than inferred from payload or kind.
Legacy completions bind to an unidentified stream only when exactly one stream of that kind in that turn can be its source; otherwise the completion stands alone.
Partial cards reload one item (bounded at 4,000 frames) or state that the beginning cannot be reconstructed. No whole-transcript backfill and no invented text.
Scroll anchoring keys on olderLoads (a completed page read), so live appends never move a reader. scroll-behavior:smooth was removed because it made follow-scroll look like leaving the live edge.
currentThreadId prefers the deterministic local thread id over most-recently-updated, so an archived thread cannot be labelled current.

R05.next_action: R06 (Aurora visual identity) is eligible once R05 is checkpointed; R07 remains independent. R06 restyles the dashboard, grip and focus-only surfaces R05 added; read design tokens and the contrast tests first.
notes: The focused layout is on when the stored preference is on OR the window is in native full screen; the preference is a project-view record and the OS state is never persisted or restored.

setFullScreen returns before AppKit finishes the Space animation, so the smoke waits for the transition event, not isFullScreen(); an early run that quit mid-animation left the next launch unable to transition, which is why the runner never quits mid-transition.
A request macOS never answers is dropped after settleMs and re-published, so `pending` cannot latch and disable the control permanently (regression test included).

The composer's maximum is measured against the live stage and the composer's own chrome, and a ResizeObserver re-clamps it on resize, zoom and layout change; a host with no layout (jsdom) falls back to documented bounds instead of collapsing to the minimum.

The composer is not a scroll container in this layout: the command list is absolutely positioned above it and an overflow here clipped the list (caught in review, fixed, and now proven by a hit test and r05-focus-command-menu.png).

Independent review returned FAIL with three major-or-worse defects (clipped autocomplete, an un-re-clamped composer at 200%, dashboard facts hidden without a drawer route) and eight smaller ones; all were fixed with checks that fail without the fix (RD-011).
Host facts observed during the round: macOS ignores a full-screen request from an inactive app, and an Electron probe left running held activation so every attempt failed until it was cleaned up.

The R03 command smoke re-run shows 25/26 with tui_only_explained failing on R04's replacement wording; that is pre-existing drift between two closed tasks and R12 owns it. Its two captures were restored to their committed bytes.
Full screen has no renderer accelerator: Control-Command-F is the AppKit role, so one press cannot toggle twice. Focus keeps its 200 ms guard, now shell-tested.
